pre_patch_status_flow.pre_patch_false_pass_rule: overall_status reduced to pass when every stage dict status normalized into {success, warning, pass, skipped}
pre_patch_status_flow.pre_patch_warning_collapse: _summarize_stage_failure returned PASS for warning-bearing stage results

confirmed_false_pass_paths.path: Required governed stages db_runtime_validation and patch_chain_validation were excluded by full-mode selection, emitted skipped, and still permitted a clean overall pass.
Warning-bearing stages such as hygiene_validation were collapsed to PASS in stage_results, obscuring degraded state and preserving false clean-pass eligibility.

changes: Extended status normalization to preserve warning, not_applicable, and not_executed states.
Added governed stage policy construction so full-mode clean-pass eligibility evaluates every stage in the authoritative stage plan.
Changed stage-result summarization to emit WARNING, SKIPPED_REQUIRED, NOT_EXECUTED_REQUIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE, and UNKNOWN_STATUS instead of collapsing non-clean states to PASS.
Added fail-closed reduction that distinguishes pass, warning, incomplete, and fail outcomes and records missing, degraded, incomplete, failed, and unknown stage sets.
Changed process exit semantics so only a clean overall pass exits successfully.

post_patch_status_flow.clean_pass_rule: overall_status=pass only when every currently applicable required governed stage has a clean PASS stage_result and no degraded, incomplete, missing, failed, or unknown required stage remains

preserved: PASS remains the only clean-success terminal status.
changed: overall_status may now be warning or incomplete rather than silently collapsing to pass.
Any overall_status other than pass now exits non-zero to keep process outcome aligned with validation outcome.

remaining_stage_work_accounting_gap.statement: This patch does not redefine substantive work accounting for individual stages. items_checked undercounting and stage-local zero-work semantics remain deferred to a separate stage-work-accounting patch.
